MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

   D. Tertiary consumers

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)

19. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.

21. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
